name: motusai-seed
author: MotusAI
description: Secure local plugin and capability runtime for desktop applications.

scripts.dev: npm run config:dev && npm run build:sdk && concurrently -k "npm:dev:renderer" "npm:dev:electron:compile" "npm:dev:electron:run"
scripts.dev:electron:run: wait-on tcp:5173 file:dist/electron/main/index.js && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 node scripts/run-electron-dev.mjs
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run config:build && npm run build:sdk && npm run typecheck:raw && npm run build:electron && npm run build:renderer
scripts.typecheck: npm run config:dev && npm run build:sdk && npm run typecheck:raw
scripts.typecheck:raw: npm run check -w @motus-ai/seed-sdk && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run config:dev && npm run build:sdk && vitest run --configLoader native
scripts.package: npm run icons:generate && npm run python:prepare && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs
scripts.package:mac: npm run icons:generate && npm run python:prepare && npm run build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --mac --publish never -c.mac.identity=- -c.mac.hardenedRuntime=false && node scripts/create-update-feed.mjs
scripts.package:win: npm run icons:generate && npm run python:prepare && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --win --publish never && node scripts/create-update-feed.mjs
scripts.package:dir: npm run icons:generate && npm run python:prepare && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --dir
